name: lemma-codex
description: Capture each completed Codex turn as a Lemma trace without MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Trace completed Codex turns in Lemma
interface.longDescription: Uses Codex lifecycle hooks to assemble prompts, tool calls, tool results, and the final assistant response into one complete Lemma trace per turn. Session IDs link those traces into a conversation.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me connect this Codex installation to Lemma tracing.
